app.title: Sprengmeister
app.tagline: Dig your way to the crate. If you dare.

orientation.headline: Turn your phone upright
orientation.body: Sprengmeister is played in portrait — the field sits flat on the table.

title.disclaimer: Drinking game, 18+. Drink responsibly — water counts too.

lobby.headline: Who's digging?
lobby.tooFewPlayers: With two of you, you always know who planted it. Grab someone else.

doubleAgent.name: Double agent
doubleAgent.hint: One live mine, one dud. You see who planted it — not whether it blows.

nightDigger.name: Night digger
nightDigger.hint: No temperature hints. Just worms and gut feeling.

twoChests.name: Two crates
twoChests.hint: Two crates, half the tokens each. The round ends on the second find.

chainReaction.name: Chain reaction
chainReaction.hint: One blast sets off the neighbours. Nobody drinks for it — but everyone sees who planted them.

masterBonus.name: Demolition bonus
masterBonus.hint: Two victims in one round: bonus token. Only ever dug your own mines: one sip.

pass.tapToStart: Tap when nobody else is looking

place.headline: Plant {count} mines.
place.tooltip: Your own mines can't hurt YOU. Remember where they are.
place.timeUp: Time's up — the rest was buried at random.

dig.tooltip: Hot = the crate is right next door.
dig.timeUp: Time's up — a random plate was dug.

place.title: Planting
place.body: The phone goes around. Everyone secretly buries two mines. Your own mines can't hurt you — remember where they are.

dig.title: Digging
dig.body: Take turns opening one plate. Someone else's mine: you drink 2 per mine, and the planter's colour flares over the crater.

hints.title: Hints
hints.body: Every empty hole shows how close the crate is: Hot (right next door), Warm (two plates away), Cold (further off).

payout.title: Payout
payout.body: Whoever gets blown up drinks straight away. Planters and the finder collect tokens and hand them out at the end of the round — just not to themselves.

dialog.abortRoundBody: The mines you buried are gone then.
